patch.value: GH-921/GH-922: merge-decision receipts are not durable in fresh-clone CI

Pending merge-decision receipts live only in clone-local ignored state, so a fresh checkout cannot distinguish a lossy concurrent merge; history-repair can erase the last tracked drift signal and make discarded work pass strict health.
Discarded-value provenance and acknowledgment are durable, pushed, and enforceable from a fresh clone before repair can make the workspace green.
The merge-performing clone sees a pending decision, but a fresh clone loses it; after history-repair, strict health can pass a commit that discarded a peer edit.
